description.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> <@ba.vup>+{phy_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. This effect can reach {max_stack:0} stacks. If the target already has {stack_cond:0} stack(s) of <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains an additional Physical DMG <@ba.vup>+{phy_dmg_up2:0%}</> for {duration2}s. This effect cannot stack.
